signals.note: max_position_error is the engine-versus-model drift WP02.4 calibrated; frames_advanced is the horizon verified_alive rests on

calibration.tolerance_source: /mnt/d/WorkShop/Touhou_RL/.tmp_v410_wp02_audit/teacher1000.jsonl (sha256=a1d6923efd8398619632d086bd854677e27cfd501158d2aeaafb37c9ca2f434b, died_false_plans=3251, covered=3226, coverage=0.992310, mismatch_count=25, rule='smallest grid threshold with coverage >= 0.99 of died=false verified plans, capped at 16.0 px')
calibration.rule: smallest grid threshold with coverage >= 0.99 of died=false verified plans, capped at 16.0 px
calibration.applied_to: every decision row's verified plans via convert_teacher_row_calibrated; the probe does not re-implement the rule

consistency.note: deaths_observed counts committed deaths (STATE f6 increases); died_true counts verified plans whose replay died. They are different measurements and are reported side by side

sample.selection: deterministic: every died=True verified plan, ordered by (decision, plan_index), first --sample-limit rows

not_claimed: not a G410-1 result: this is one real teacher run used to put a verified_dead sample on disk; no gate, threshold or release check is evaluated or satisfied here
not a dataset: one stage, one seed, one difficulty and the teacher's own run; nothing was trained, collected, augmented or replayed into a shard
not a survival rate: a single death says the teacher lost this episode, not how often it loses stage 7
not a rewrite of WP02.4: the calibration, its tolerance and the seed-1000 corpus are read-only here; only the new death sample is written
limits: single run scope: one stage/seed/difficulty. Another stage or mode may never die, and that would be a different measurement, not a broader claim

verified_dead is the engine's died=True verdict passed through WP02.4's classify_plan; the death proves the label branch is reachable on the real engine, not that every died plan is labelled correctly
the position tolerance is WP02.4's fitted 8.0 px model-consistency threshold; for a died plan it is informational only, the verdict does not depend on it
stop_reason=death is the teacher's own stop-on-death rule (a committed STATE f6 increase); a run at the frame cap is alive, not a death
40 plan(s) are 'unknown' under the calibrated rule and are not negative samples; only died=True plans become verified_dead
